newsitem.title: UK: BT appoints EuroTel Bratislava as distributor.
newsitem.headline: BT appoints EuroTel Bratislava as distributor.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Wednesday it had appointed U.S.-Slovak mobile telephone joint venture EuroTel Bratislava to distribute BT's Concert services in the Slovak Republic.
EuroTel is a joint venture between state-owned monopoly Slovenske Telekomunikacie s.p. Slovak and U.S groups Bell Atlantic Corp. and U.S. West Media Group Inc..
BT is planning to merge with U.S. group MCI Communications Corp.. The proposed group will be called Concert Plc and will aim to service multinational companies.
BT said EuroTel was the leading provider of telecommunications services in Slovakia and said demand continued to grow rapidly.
